integrity.cone_basis: Fu's archival full text explicitly records the scalar C* action on nilpotent orbits using Jacobson--Morozov.
integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity identifies it with ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A generic cocharacter separates all root weights, so projective fixed points are the Cartan projective space and individual root lines.
integrity.nilpotent_basis: The projectivized orbit closure meets no Cartan direction; long root vectors lie in the unique minimal nonzero orbit, and short root vectors form one additional orbit when two root lengths occur.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: Fu--Namikawa's published nilpotent-orbit-closure paper is classified 14E15; the direction is algebraic geometry.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes ordinary Euler characteristic only, not finer cohomological or singularity invariants.
For non-simply-laced types, deciding which orbit closures contain the short-root-vector orbit is delegated to the standard nilpotent-orbit closure order.
The fixed-point proof is short, so an older unindexed or folklore statement may exist.
title: Projectivized nilpotent orbit closures have at most two Euler characteristics in each simple Lie type
